status: FROZEN — this is the LAST post-hoc change to the VCP detection METHOD. From here the method is frozen; any future change is a NEW pre-registered decision that starts its OWN forward series.
decision: The degenerate D50 reference contraction detector was a BUG (it over-segments real daily bars into 15-40 micro-contractions, so 'each <=0.75x prior' can never hold and Stage 3 collapses to 0). The faithful ZigZag swing-detection detector is the correct implementation and is hereby frozen as the canonical VCP method.

method.rule: Build alternating swing highs/lows over the base window; a reversal is registered only after price moves >= swing_reversal_pct off the running extreme. Pullback depths = each swing HIGH down to the following swing LOW. Require >= min_contractions pullbacks with successive tightening (each <= tightness_ratio_max x the prior), volume dry-up into the pivot, and base depth <= max_base_depth_pct. Pivot/buy-point = highest swing high in the base.
method.reversal_knob_note: swing_reversal_pct = 4.0 is THE knob the funnel count is most sensitive to (count swings ~0-4 across plausible values). It is NOW pre-registered at 4.0 and frozen. This closes the open gap flagged in the 2026-06-26 run's honest_read.
method.anti_look_ahead: Detector reads bars[0..signal_index] only (proven by pipeline.py truncation self-test).
